question: The process of depositing a layer of any desired metal on another material, by means of electricity, is called _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**electroplating**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Electroplating (also known as electrodeposition) **is a **method of reducing cations of the desired metal **in solution and forming a metallic coating using an electrical signal supplied by an external power source.
 
• Electroplating is a method of applying a metallic coating to a substrate. Heat tolerance and corrosion resistance are improved by electroplating a substrate material.
 
• Because electrodeposition is accomplished through a crystalline mechanism, electroplating is an electrocrystallization process.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **An electrode** is an electric conductor, generally made of metal, that conducts current into and out of an electrically conducting medium, which can be an electrolytic solution, such as in a storage battery, or a solid, gas, or vacuum.
 
• **An electromagnet **is a device that consists of a magnetic core encircled by a coil through which an electric current is carried to magnetise the core.
 
• **A conductor **is an object or type of material in physics and electrical engineering that permits charge (electric current) to travel in one or more directions.
